label: Interior University Society print mark
note: Reconstructed from photographed campaign print and stationery. Right-aligned lettering and three projecting orange bars follow the source; original fonts and precise colours remain unconfirmed.

label: Society enamel pin
note: Flat vector reconstruction of the clipped-corner pin, with orange enamel, burgundy bars and metal surrounds. Dimensions, finish and lettering weight are approximate; this is not a manufacturing drawing.

label: Northern U button
note: Version 1.2 includes the corrected, independently drawn capital N, fitted Bookman-derived lowercase letters and a separate large U. The original font, orange colour and button diameter remain unconfirmed.

label: I say yes to Northern Interior University button
note: Rebuilt from the photographed campaign button, including geometric NORTHERN and collegiate INTERIOR lettering. Typefaces, paper tint and physical dimensions are approximate.

label: I support the Interior University sticker
note: Reconstructed yellow supporter sticker. The wording and arrangement follow the photographs; typeface, proportions and stock colour are estimates.

label: Historical toll-free sticker
note: Reconstructed society contact sticker. Its telephone number is historical documentary content, not a current contact. Fonts, frame and ink colours are approximate.

label: Invitation dated 8 June 1988
note: Re-typeset study of the photographed invitation, retaining its DAHLLOFF / Dahlloff spelling. This records use of the identity in 1988, not its design date. Contact details are historical; uncertain header text and handwritten marks are omitted.

label: Membership and supporter card
note: Rebuilt layout showing the photographed $10 voting-member and $5 supporter options. Unreadable declaration text, serial numbers and signatures are omitted. This is historical artwork, not a current registration form.

label: Support Campaign brochure cover
note: Reconstructed cover with a newly drawn interpretation of the ten-graduate illustration. It preserves the broad composition, not the original artist's detailed drawing; proportions and paper colour are estimated.

label: Business fundraising appeal
note: Re-typeset study of the photographed $100 business appeal for a university in Prince George. Fonts and line breaks are reconstructed; the address and donation amount are historical, and the obscured salutation and signature are omitted.

label: Letterhead template
note: Source-derived stationery with a vertical society mark and rose-red top rule. The uncertain small address block is omitted. The Letter-size canvas is a modern output choice, not a measured original.

label: Supporter-only card
note: Rebuilt supporter form with the photographed $5 non-voting wording. Unreadable declaration text is omitted and grid proportions are approximate. This is not a current registration or payment form.

label: Supporter petition spread
note: Re-typeset petition panel and supporter form. Reflections and occlusion limit the original photographs: punctuation and line breaks are reconstruction choices, and unreadable fine print is omitted. Phone and donation information is historical.

label: Print mark in black
note: Single-colour reproduction of the reconstructed print mark. This export does not establish a separately documented historical colourway. Original lettering remains approximated.

label: Print mark in white
note: White-on-transparent reproduction of the reconstructed print mark, intended for a dark background. This export does not establish a separately documented historical colourway.

label: Reversed print mark on a dark panel
note: Reversed reproduction with an optional dark vector panel. Historical use of this exact panel is not verified.

label: Vertical stationery mark
note: The print reconstruction rotated to match the orientation visible on photographed society letterhead. Letterforms, proportions and colours remain approximations.

label: One-colour pin adaptation
note: Single-ink adaptation of the reconstructed enamel pin. This reproduction is not presented as a surviving historical pin variant.

label: Compact reconstruction alternative
note: Vector version of an earlier supplied raster clean-up. It is a contemporary reconstruction alternative, not independent historical evidence or an additional documented identity.

label: Extended reconstruction alternative
note: Vector version of an earlier supplied raster clean-up with extended bars. It is a contemporary reconstruction alternative, not an additional documented historical identity.

label: Interior University sweatshirt lettering
note: Interpretive lettering based on a small, partly obscured photograph. INTERIOR is visible, while the lower UNIVERSITY line is completed by inference. Exact letterforms, curve and print colour are unconfirmed.

label: Ten graduates illustration
note: Newly constructed vector drawing informed by the brochure's ten-figure composition. Faces, folds and fine linework are interpretations, not recovered original artwork.

label: Pin silhouette
note: Separate editable silhouette estimated from the photographed pin. It is not a measured manufacturing cutline or a separately documented historical mark.

label: Three-bar graphic component
note: Separately editable bars from the print reconstruction. This is a useful construction component, not evidence of a historical standalone symbol.

label: A university for Prince George headline
note: Re-typeset campaign wording from the fundraising letter using substitute italic outlines. It is a lettering component, not a separately documented logo.

label: Support Campaign wording
note: Separate lettering reconstructed from the photographed brochure cover. Spacing and typography are approximate.
